description: This file defines the MyGLRenderer class which implements rendering logic for an OpenGL ES context in an Android application. It manages drawing a triangle and a square, handles surface creation, changes, and frame rendering, and includes rotation controls for the triangle.

classes.name: MyGLRenderer
classes.description: Implements the GLSurfaceView.Renderer interface, providing methods to create, update, and resize the OpenGL rendering surface, and maintains the state of drawable objects and rotation angle.

methods.name: onSurfaceCreated
methods.description: Initializes the OpenGL environment, sets background color, and creates drawable objects (Triangle and Square).

methods.name: onDrawFrame
methods.description: Clears the screen and depth buffer, resets transformations, sets camera view, and draws a square and a rotating triangle.

methods.name: onSurfaceChanged
methods.description: Adjusts the viewport and projection matrix according to surface size changes, such as orientation shifts.

methods.name: getAngle
methods.description: Returns the current rotation angle of the triangle.

methods.name: setAngle
methods.description: Sets the rotation angle of the triangle.
